18/S0.subgoal: Summarize the progress so far and introduce the broad categorization of tracking technologies.

18/S1.subgoal: Describe the different types of electromechanical trackers and their use cases.

18/S2.subgoal: Explain electromagnetic and acoustic tracking technologies.

18/S3.subgoal: Identify the categories of vision-based tracking and explain infrared tracking.

18/S4.subgoal: Describe the different techniques for visible light tracking, including fiducial, natural feature, and model-based tracking.

18/S5.subgoal: Describe 3D structure and inertial tracking technologies.

18/S6.subgoal: Describe specialized tracking methods including GPS, motion capture, eye-tracking, and hybrid systems.

18/S7.subgoal: Summarize the main points of the lecture and preview the next topic.
